summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (bug fixes and test infrastructure), review the code for quality, get a PR merged, and fix a flaky recovery E2E test that was failing in CI.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 was executed and merged (PR #361). Multiple CI failures were debugged and resolved. A root cause was discovered: the vault key blob IPNS publish was missing from the SDK, causing recovery E2E test failures. A new SDK function `publishVaultKeyBlob` was extracted from `useAuth.ts` and wired into `createTestAccount` (PR #368).

repo: The vault key blob IPNS publish (deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair → serializeVaultBlobV2 → addToIpfs → createAndPublishIpnsRecord) only existed in the web app's useAuth.ts hook, not in the SDK — meaning createTestAccount and CipherBoxClient silently skipped it.
In CI, IPNS records are published through mock-ipns-routing (port 3001) via delegated routing, NOT through Kubo's DHT. Kubo's gateway (/ipns/ path) cannot resolve these records.
The CipherBox API's /ipns/resolve endpoint requires JWT authentication, making it unusable from recovery.html which is a standalone unauthenticated tool.
The device registry was upgraded from v1 to v2 schema: SHA-256 ipHash replaces empty string, v1→v2 migration is lenient on read but strict on write.
publishWithVerify in bin/index.ts was refactored to publish once then retry only verification — the prior implementation re-published on every retry attempt.
Kubo CORS headers must be explicitly configured for browser-based tools to make cross-origin requests to the Kubo API or gateway ports.

The byo-file-workload.ts cid/pinSize variables must be declared outside the try block so the finally block can access them — TypeScript does not propagate try-block narrowing to sibling finally blocks.

code.finding: New module created: publishVaultKeyBlob and loadVaultKeyBlob extracted from useAuth.ts into sdk-core so any SDK consumer gets vault key blob IPNS publishing.
createAndPublishIpnsRecord for vault key blob is called here — this was the only place in the codebase doing it, which is why createTestAccount never published the vault key blob.
API base is derived from window.location.origin replacing port with 3000. The /ipns/resolve fallback requires JWT auth (JwtAuthGuard on IpnsController) so it always 401s from recovery.html.

After extracting validateRegistryShape helper, the obj.devices narrowing doesn't propagate to callers — requires explicit 'as unknown[]' cast. Also auto-heal should only fix empty string ipHash, not other malformed values.
loadBin auto-repair: resolveIpnsRecord returns null on explicit 404 but throws on transient errors — so auto-repair only triggers on confirmed missing records, not network blips.
CORS headers added to allow browser access. Restricted to GET and OPTIONS only since the browser only reads IPNS records.
createTestAccount was missing vault key blob IPNS publish step — added publishVaultKeyBlob call after vault registration.
IPNS_GATEWAY env var should default to DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL (mock-ipns-routing port) not the CipherBox API, since the API requires auth for IPNS resolution.

workflow: When a browser-based tool needs to resolve IPNS names in CI, the mock-ipns-routing service is the correct target — not the CipherBox API (auth required) or Kubo gateway (records not in DHT).
Stale package .d.ts files can cause cascading TypeScript errors across packages — rebuilding crypto and api-client packages resolved 6 phantom web app type errors.
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded error in Claude Code is a runtime bug that fires after agent tool calls complete — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine true success.
When merging planning-file conflicts between two completed phases, both sets of changes must be preserved — ROADMAP, STATE, REQUIREMENTS, and PROJECT all need merged content from both phases.
Pre-checking resource existence before operating (TOCTOU) is an anti-pattern — operate directly and handle errors.

friction: Multiple CI iterations (5+ PRs) needed to fix the recovery E2E test due to layered root causes: missing SDK_E2E_SECRET → Kubo CORS not configured → API /ipns/resolve requires auth → mock-ipns-routing missing CORS → vault key blob never published by createTestAccount.
GitHub API timeouts made it difficult to fetch CI logs directly, requiring workarounds.
Background bash tasks failing silently (exit 128) due to race conditions with the main thread doing the same push — required manual verification.
The TypeScript narrowing issue with validateRegistryShape required an 'as unknown[]' cast because control-flow narrowing doesn't cross function call boundaries.
Kubo CORS is not configured by default and requires ipfs config commands + restart, which is non-obvious for local dev and must be explicitly added to CI workflows.
The try/finally scoping issue with cid/pinSize in byo-file-workload.ts required multiple edit attempts to get right.
open_items: Todo filed: simplify useAuth.ts to call the new SDK publishVaultKeyBlob function instead of duplicating the logic inline (currently both exist).
PR #367 (test.skip for recovery E2E in CI) should be closed without merging once PR #368 lands and CI confirms the recovery test passes.
Recovery E2E test cannot run locally without CORS configured on Kubo — needs documentation or a docker-compose override for the dev environment.
The recovery.html base64 private key fallback was removed as dead code for v2, but this removes any future flexibility for alternative key formats.
SDK integration tests for bin operations have 2 persistent failures due to API not running locally — these are silently skipped in the unit test suite but would be caught in SDK E2E.
